normal_summon_callers.name: Enra
normal_summon_callers.printed_text: Cannot be Special Summoned. When your Spirit monster is Normal Summoned: You can, immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon this card from your hand, then you can Normal Summon 1 Spirit monster.
